answer: Make every identity serve a proving season before full pay: rewards earned in its first epochs sit frozen like a river delta in tundra, released only after it keeps answering fresh challenges over time. A sybil operator can mint a thousand names in one tide, but each must be fed real generations for weeks while its escrow stays locked; abandon one and the escrow burns. Time, not paperwork, is the toll, and time cannot be parallelized for free.
